subtitle.zh: 从原子迁移、热预算到结深与电性
subtitle.en: From atomic migration and thermal budget to junction depth and electrical behavior

body.zh: 导入或重新分布掺杂，塑造需要的浓度与结深
body.en: Introduce or redistribute dopants to obtain the required concentration and junction depth
Obtain the required concentration and junction depth

body.zh: 原子沿浓度梯度迁移，扩散速度对温度高度敏感
body.en: Atoms migrate along concentration gradients; the diffusion rate is highly temperature-sensitive

body.zh: 掺杂原子在晶格中跳迁
body.en: Dopant atoms hop through the crystal lattice

body.zh: 温度越高，扩散越快，分布更深
body.en: Higher temperature accelerates diffusion and extends the profile deeper

body.zh: 源强、表面状态与边界条件先决定导入能力
body.en: Source strength, surface condition and boundary conditions first determine dopant introduction

body.zh: 不同摻杂源提供不同的表面浓度
body.en: Different dopant sources provide different surface concentrations

body.zh: 先建立掺杂量，再调整分布深度与形状
body.en: First establish the dopant dose, then adjust profile depth and shape

body.zh: 结深由完整热历史决定，不只看峰值温度
body.en: Junction depth depends on the complete thermal history, not only peak temperature

body.zh: 完整的热历史构成热预算
body.en: The complete thermal history constitutes the thermal budget

body.zh: 时间越长或温度越高，结深越深
body.en: Longer time or higher temperature produces deeper junctions

body.zh: 氧化层既可能阻挡掺杂，也会改变界面附近扩散
body.en: An oxide can block dopants and alter diffusion near the interface

body.zh: 平均片阻正常，也可能掩盖片内或批间异常
body.en: An acceptable average sheet resistance can conceal within-wafer or batch-to-batch anomalies

body.zh: 炉舟不同位置存在温度/气氛差异
body.en: Temperature/ambient differ with position in the furnace boat

body.zh: 导致批间或片间均匀性问题
Diff、离子注入与退火职责不同，不能简单互相替代
body.en: Diffusion, implantation and annealing have different roles and are not simply interchangeable

body.zh: • 适合阱区、［字迹不清］化层等

body.en: • High temperatures and long process times
• Shallow profiles; suitable for shallow junctions

body.zh: • 促使掺杂扩散与重分布
根据器件需求选择合适工艺
body.en: Select the process to suit device requirements

body.zh: 三种工艺各有侧重，服务不同目标
